optional_choice.prompt: The starving garrison offers to surrender their hidden armory keys in exchange for safe passage north.
optional_choice.a: Grant safe passage to preserve your soldiers' strength.
optional_choice.b: Refuse terms and storm the keep to prevent them from rejoining the enemy.
optional_choice.effect_a: Saves troop casualties; released veterans reinforce the enemy in m35.
optional_choice.effect_b: Eliminates enemy reinforcements in m35; costs 20% frontline health in final assault.

m30-starved-bastion.codex_note: Quarried from pale coastal chalk, High-Orchard Redoubt has no well of its own, relying entirely on mountain cisterns and pack-mule trains.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Black river water thunders eighty feet below two stone spans, held back by rust-red iron sluice gates.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: See those counterweights on the center island? One pull of a lever and fifty tons of river sweeps both bridges clean.

intro_scene.speaker: field-harbor-pilot
intro_scene.line: We take the island redoubt first, lock the gears with iron wedges, then bring the main host across.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Send the light vanguard onto the island. Nobody steps onto the east bridge until the gears are jammed.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: Listen to that brass chime from the cliffs—looks like someone's already manning The Bell-Tower Picket.

intro_scene.speaker: field-harbor-pilot
intro_scene.line: Let them ring. Once those sluices are wedged, the river belongs to us.

milestones.speaker: field-harbor-pilot
milestones.line: Crossbowmen on the sluice gallery! Clear the winches before they trip the floodgates!

milestones.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
milestones.line: Wedges driven into the main gear-teeth! The sluices are locked—send the heavy infantry over!

milestones.speaker: field-salt-corporal
milestones.line: Enemy engineers swimming with crowbars to pry the wedges loose! Guard the winch house!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: East bank garrison is pinned against the gorge. Finish them.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
victory_epilogue.line: Those gears won't turn again without a foundry crew and six months of scaffolding.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-harbor-pilot
victory_epilogue.line: The deep harbor road is clear. We can smell the coal smoke from Harborwatch already.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Keep a squad on the island until the baggage train finishes crossing.

m31-riverlock-crossing.defeat_line: Iron chains scream as the floodgates drop, and a wall of black river water sweeps your vanguard into the gorge.
m31-riverlock-crossing.codex_note: Engineered to regulate winter snowmelt for the valley mills, the Twin Riverlocks can flood the lower canyon in less than forty heartbeats.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Pine needles tremble on the ridge path as something vast shifts among the boulders above.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
intro_scene.line: That's no boulder, boss. It's got moss in its joints and eyes like banked furnace coals.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
intro_scene.line: Our iron broadheads bounced off its chest like hailstones. Standard steel won't even scratch that hide.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Keep the infantry dispersed. Use arcane fire and armor-piercing bolts on the glowing seams.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
intro_scene.line: Every time it stamps, the ground splits wide enough to swallow a horse!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
intro_scene.line: Stay light on your feet and aim for the rune-cracks when it kneels.

milestones.speaker: field-salt-corporal
milestones.line: Scatter! Don't bunch up or one shockwave will break every leg in the squad!

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: Left knee-joint is smoking! Pour every arcane charge you have into that fissure!

milestones.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
milestones.line: Rockslides coming down the ridge! Keep moving—standing still is suicide!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Its core rune is exposed. Strike it now before it regains its footing.

ambient_barks: Don't get cornered on the cliff!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
victory_epilogue.line: Just a pile of grey gravel now. Even the birds are coming back to the pines.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
victory_epilogue.line: The mountain pass is open, and our mages harvested enough earth-core dust to fill three flasks.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Take the ridge road before the cult realizes their sentinel is dead.

m32-elder-juggernaut.defeat_line: A tectonic stomp splits the granite ridge beneath your boots, burying the expedition under tons of ancient stone.

optional_choice.prompt: The shattered Juggernaut's chest cavity holds a pulsing earth-core crystal and slabs of rune-carved lodestone.
optional_choice.a: Extract the earth-core to empower your battle-mages.
optional_choice.b: Harvest the lodestone slabs to reinforce your siege wagons.
optional_choice.effect_a: Increases spell damage by +20% through Act 4; causes unstable magic backlash on critical misses.
optional_choice.effect_b: Grants +25% siege durability in Act 4 (m38, m42); leaves mages without arcane reserves.

m32-elder-juggernaut.codex_note: Elder Juggernauts were bound from living bedrock during the Age of Chains to guard mountain borders long after their creators turned to dust.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Lanterns glint off gilded ironwork inside Baron Vane's keep, where pack-mules wait in the postern yard.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
intro_scene.line: Two vaults flanking the hall, crammed with silver ingots meant to buy every sellsword from here to the straits.

intro_scene.speaker: field-salt-corporal
intro_scene.line: His treasurers are already loading chests onto the catacomb lifts. If they drop the portcullis, that gold vanishes.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Drive straight through the center gate. Ignore the side towers until the vault doors are ours.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
intro_scene.line: His household halberdiers are dressed in plate thicker than a ship's hull.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Heavy armor slows them down. Hit them before they form ranks.

milestones.speaker: field-salt-corporal
milestones.line: Main gate is breached! Push past the courtyard fountain—don't get bogged down on the walls!

milestones.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
milestones.line: West vault secured! Treasurers are fleeing toward the east strongroom with the royal seals!

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: The Baron's personal guard is blocking the throne stair! Break their pike-wall!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Baron Vane is cornered by the catacomb grate. Take the keys.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
victory_epilogue.line: Never seen so much stamped gold in one room. Half the mercenary guilds on the coast just lost their employer.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
victory_epilogue.line: With these regalia and coin-chests, we can pay our veterans double through the final campaign.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Seal the chests under armed guard and prepare for the coastal hills.

m33-high-stakes-gambit.defeat_line: Baron Vane's halberdiers hold the stair while the last iron lift drops into the dark catacombs with the war-chest.

optional_choice.prompt: Baron Vane's ledger reveals extortion contracts held over Oakhaven's merchant families alongside hidden bullion.
optional_choice.a: Burn the debt ledgers to win Oakhaven's unconditional loyalty.
optional_choice.b: Collect the debts immediately to swell your war-chest.
optional_choice.effect_a: Unlocks free veteran reinforcements in m35 and Act 4; forfeits 600 gold.
optional_choice.effect_b: Gains +600 gold immediately; Oakhaven levies suffer -15% morale in m35.

m33-high-stakes-gambit.codex_note: Baron Vane inherited a salt-tax monopoly and turned his ancestral manor into a counting-house for traitors, pirates, and shadow-brokers.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Two mercenary hosts hack at each other across a muddy hollow, trampled banners sinking into churned turf.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: The Ironclads and the Ashen Company—butchering each other over the loot from three burned fishing towns.

intro_scene.speaker: field-salt-corporal
intro_scene.line: If we wait until one side wins, we face a victorious warlord. If we strike now, both lines are tangled.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: Watch their supply wagons on the ridge—they're hauling Pitch for the Fire-Ships down to Harborwatch.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Drive a wedge straight between their standards. Kill both commanders before they sound a truce.

intro_scene.speaker: field-salt-corporal
intro_scene.line: Once their warlords drop, sellswords always remember how to surrender.

milestones.speaker: field-salt-corporal
milestones.line: We're in their flanks! Neither banner saw us coming through the hollow!

milestones.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
milestones.line: Ironclad warlord is down! Watch out—the Ashen Banner is trying to rally the survivors!

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: They're turning their pikes toward us together—break the Ashen standard before they link shields!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Both warlords are dead. Offer steel or submission to the rest.

ambient_barks: Don't let them form a truce!

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-salt-corporal
victory_epilogue.line: Three hundred sellswords threw down their pikes the moment the Ashen standard hit the mud.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
victory_epilogue.line: They'll haul supplies and dig trenches for us now—and Harborwatch just lost its hired garrison.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Put them in the vanguard for the harbor assault. Let them earn their pardons.

m34-clashing-banners.defeat_line: The rival banners lock shields around your surrounded column, turning the muddy hollow into a killing pen.
m34-clashing-banners.codex_note: Free companies along the Iron Coast swear oaths only to coin and steel; their banners are stitched from salvaged sailcloth dyed in rust and soot.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Harborwatch's piers roar like open furnaces as pitch-pots rain down from Admiral Kael's black-sailed flagship.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: Two hundred years of shipwright craft burning to ash! If we don't retake the seawall batteries, the whole bay dies.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
intro_scene.line: Smoke is choking the lower avenues, and cultists are herding dockworkers toward the flaming warehouses.

intro_scene.speaker: vesperion
intro_scene.line: Look upon your harbor, mortal. Even the sea refuses to quench what the Crown has kindled.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: That voice from the flagship—Vesperion's herald commands the fleet. Take the batteries and turn their own catapults on them.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-sera-healer
intro_scene.line: My medics will douse the pier-heads behind you. Just keep those fire-pots off our backs!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
intro_scene.line: Once the seawall guns speak, I'll ram my own brigantine straight into Kael's hull so your marines can board!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Clear the burning streets. Tonight Harborwatch either rises or becomes a pyre.

milestones.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
milestones.line: Seawall stairs ahead! Cut through the arson-squads before they spike the coastal trebuchets!

milestones.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
milestones.line: Batteries reclaimed! Aim low—smash Kael's rudder so his flagship can't slip the harbor!

milestones.speaker: vesperion
milestones.line: Burn, little insects. Your cinders will pave the road to the volcanic throne!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Grappling hooks are fast on the flagship. Board her and end Admiral Kael.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
victory_epilogue.line: Kael's flagship is sinking in the channel, and Vesperion's phantom vanished with the smoke.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
victory_epilogue.line: The fire-brigades saved the drydocks. Half the fleet is scorched, but enough hulls float to carry our army south.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-sera-healer
victory_epilogue.line: Beyond the straits lies the volcanic heartland. Nothing there grows—nothing there forgives.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Load the transports at high tide. We take the war to their hearth.

m35-burning-harbor.defeat_line: Driven onto the blazing piers with burning oil behind and deep water ahead, your army is consumed by Harborwatch's flames.

optional_choice.prompt: As Kael's flagship sinks, marines can rescue either locked chests of volcanic navigation charts or trapped Harborwatch shipwrights.
optional_choice.a: Save the shipwrights to repair your fleet.
optional_choice.b: Seize the volcanic sea-charts before the cabin collapses.
optional_choice.effect_a: Provides extra troop transports and +15% unit recovery entering Act 4 (m36).
optional_choice.effect_b: Reveals enemy patrol routes and grants +15% ambush damage in Act 4 (m36, m37).

m35-burning-harbor.codex_note: Harborwatch was the jewel of the Iron Coast, its lighthouse fueled by refined whale-oil that burned visible for forty leagues through winter gales.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Black glass sand crunches underfoot as grey ash drifts down from a sky without sun or stars.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Welcome to the slag-lands. Keep your visors down—the grit here chews through leather and lung alike.

intro_scene.speaker: field-ash-scout
intro_scene.line: Highcrest bluff is two miles inland. Cultist outriders are already circling the landing coves like vultures.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Form a defensive wedge and secure Highcrest before nightfall. Without high ground, the magma vents will cook us.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: My Ironcamp veterans know this terrain. Follow their boot-prints and don't step on yellow crust.

intro_scene.speaker: field-ash-scout
intro_scene.line: Yellow crust means boiling sulfur two inches down. Keep your eyes on the ground.

milestones.speaker: field-ash-scout
milestones.line: Ash-stalkers rising out of the dunes! Watch your flanks—they blend straight into the soot!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Halfway up the bluff! Plant the iron stakes and keep the pack-wagons moving!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: Heat's warping the shield-straps! Drink sparingly—there isn't a clean spring within thirty miles!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Clear the Highcrest plateau and raise the command banner.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Trenches are dug and the windbreaks are up. Ugly ground, but it will hold against a night counterattack.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-ash-scout
victory_epilogue.line: The Infernal Sanctuary looms across the caldera—glowing like a cracked ember in the dark.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Post double sentries. Nobody sleeps without steel in reach.

m36-heartland-march.defeat_line: Pinned on the black volcanic beach with boiling surf behind and ash-demons ahead, the expedition is butchered before setting camp.
m36-heartland-march.codex_note: The Volcanic Heartland was once Thornvael's fertile breadbasket before the First Cataclysm cracked the mantle and turned orchards into obsidian.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: A dome of violet static hums across the obsidian pass, snapping blue lightning against any steel raised near it.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Three focusing beacons on those crags feed that barrier. Touch it with a pike and you'll fry inside your mail.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: Each beacon has a warden bound to its crystal. Kill the warden, crack the prism, and the dome drops.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take the beacons before the citadel's reserve legions finish mustering behind that shield.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Use ground-mauls on the crystals—swords will just bounce the discharge back into your wrists.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: Move fast. Every minute that dome hums, the beams grow hotter.

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: First beacon ridge! Keep spread out—the crystal arcs lightning between men standing close!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: Two prisms shattered! The dome is flickering—only the east crag still holds power!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Citadel outriders charging down the pass to relieve the last warden! Intercept them!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: East warden is down. Smash the last crystal.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
victory_epilogue.line: Clean shatter. The static is gone and the air smells like ozone instead of scorched hair.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: The pass lies open before their reserves could form ranks. Good timing, commander.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Collect the prism shards for Vok's forge and advance on Greystone.

m37-shattered-beacons.defeat_line: The three beacons converge their beams into a blinding lance of white fire, vaporizing your vanguard on the obsidian pass.

optional_choice.prompt: The shattered beacons leave behind volatile arcane capacitor cores and scorched obsidian lenses.
optional_choice.a: Give the cores to Forgemaster Vok to overcharge your weapons.
optional_choice.b: Use the lenses to build an early-warning array at Greystone.
optional_choice.effect_a: Grants +15% shock damage to melee units in Act 4; reduces armor durability by 10%.
optional_choice.effect_b: Grants +20% defensive sight range and artillery accuracy in m38; forfeits shock weapon bonus.

m37-shattered-beacons.codex_note: Constructed from star-fallen lodestone and bound lightning elementals, the Obsidian Beacons were designed to seal the inner caldera against imperial armies.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Cracked basalt blocks shower down from Greystone Bastion's parapet as demonic siege-engines thunder below.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Three colossal catapults are hammering my curtain wall to gravel. Another hour and there won't be a parapet left!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: My smiths are out of rivets and cold steel—we need fresh Iron on the Wall if we're going to patch these breaches.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Hold the ladders first. Once their assault wave breaks, we sally out and burn all three catapults.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Demonic brutes are turning the winches on those engines—ordinary archers won't drop them.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Then we kill them up close with fire and steel.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Grappling ladders on the west battlement! Tip them back before their brutes gain the walkway!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: First siege catapult is ablaze! Open the sally-port—hit the center battery while they're blinded by smoke!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: East wall just buckled! Plug the breach with shields—don't let them into the inner ward!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Only the last catapult remains. Burn it to ash.

ambient_barks: Hold the breach with your lives!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Greystone still stands, bruised and smoking, and our supply road back to the coast remains unbroken.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
victory_epilogue.line: My anvils are ringing again. Give me two hours and I'll have every dent hammered out of your vanguard's plate.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Repair the sally-port and prepare for pursuit into Ashveil Gorge.

m38-besieged-wall.defeat_line: Greystone's curtain wall collapses in a thunderous avalanche of basalt, burying Rowan's garrison beneath the rubble.
m38-besieged-wall.codex_note: Greystone Bastion plugs the sole wagon-wide defile into the volcanic core; its walls are mortared with pulverized pumice that hardens under heat.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Violet sparks trail down Ashveil Gorge like bleeding stars where Arch-Mage Malrik flees toward the summit gate.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: Malrik carries the desecration codices. If he steps through that summit portal, the inner sanctum's wards become unbreakable.

intro_scene.speaker: field-ash-scout
intro_scene.line: He's raising walls of jagged obsidian behind him to slow our pursuit, and leaving bound horrors in the clefts.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Push the vanguard at a forced march. Cut through his rearguard and catch him on the portal stairs.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: Do not let him finish his final incantation—his blood is bound to the gate's keystone.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Then he dies before he speaks the last syllable.

milestones.speaker: field-ash-scout
milestones.line: Obsidian barrier across the narrows! Shatter the keystone runes and keep running!

milestones.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
milestones.line: I see his crimson robe on the upper switchback! He's already channeling the summit portal!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Shadow constructs erupting from the gorge walls! Don't get pinned—keep eyes on Malrik!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: He's on the portal steps. Strike him down now!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
victory_epilogue.line: The portal collapsed the instant his heart stopped. Look at these grimoires—every leyline conduit in the citadel is mapped inside.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-ash-scout
victory_epilogue.line: Without Malrik, their outer batteries have lost their master-weaver.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Keep those books wrapped in lead-cloth. We'll need every secret inside.

m39-flight-of-malrik.defeat_line: Malrik vanishes into the blinding portal with a mocking laugh as the obsidian canyon walls cave inward atop your column.

optional_choice.prompt: Malrik's corpse clutches both his forbidden leyline grimoire and a soul-phylactery pulsing with trapped elemental essence.
optional_choice.a: Keep the grimoire intact to weaken the citadel's final wards.
optional_choice.b: Shatter the phylactery to restore your army's depleted arcane reserves.
optional_choice.effect_a: Reduces enemy ward defenses in m45 and m46; curses vanguard with -10% shadow resistance.
optional_choice.effect_b: Fully restores mage mana and heals +25% across all squads; forfeits leyline intelligence.

m39-flight-of-malrik.codex_note: Once First Archivist of the Crown College, Malrik traded his sight for the ability to read volcanic leylines like veins beneath skin.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Twin crag bastions straddle the citadel causeway like iron jaws, each housing a rune-engraved mana-cannon.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: One blast from those barrels turns a shield-wall into vapor. Marching down the center road is suicide.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: We split into two strike columns and climb the blind scree behind each crag, or hit one fast before the other can traverse.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Look at the west furnace vent—they call that trench The Unquenched Jaw. Keep clear of its slag-spouts.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Take both crags systematically. Silence the cannons before the main column steps onto the causeway.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Signal with red flares when the first breech blows so the second team knows when to strike.

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: Stay behind the basalt outcrops! The cannons fire every twenty heartbeats—move between volleys!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: West mana-cannon is spiked and burning! Now pivot everything onto the east crag!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Artillery splash just wiped out the vanguard scouts—keep climbing, the dead zone is twenty yards ahead!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: East redoubt gunners are cornered. Dismantle the last cannon.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
victory_epilogue.line: I cracked both mana-barrels with cold-iron wedges. Neither gun will ever fire again.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: The causeway to the Gauntlet is clear of artillery. Our heavy troops can march in full formation.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Bring up the siege shields. The narrow canyon comes next.

m40-twofold-assault.defeat_line: Twin beams of compressed mana sweep the causeway in crossfire, reducing your assault columns to drifting grey ash.
m40-twofold-assault.codex_note: Cast from meteoric bronze in the foundries of the deep caldera, the Twin Mana-Cannons require three bound warlocks apiece merely to cool their barrels.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Sheer iron-veined cliffs squeeze the canyon road to thirty paces wide, barred by three spiked portcullises.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: The Gauntlet of Iron. Three checkpoints, iron golems at every gate, and crossbow nests carved into the rock above.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: Among the ash-heaps by the first gate lie fragments of The Burnt Syllabus—records of how those golems were animated.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Advance under locked tower-shields. Sappers crack the gates while mages strip the cliffs.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Watch those iron golems—their chests glow white-hot right before they swing.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Every yard here costs blood. Keep the line tight and don't let them drop a gate behind us.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Shields overhead! Bolts raining from the cliff niches—advance in tortoise formation!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: Second portcullis blown! Iron golems stepping out of the side alcoves—ready armor-piercing rounds!

milestones.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
milestones.line: The canyon is choked with smoke and dead—hold your nerve, the third gate is fifty paces ahead!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Break the final checkpoint. The outer citadel wall lies just beyond.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Three checkpoints taken, and every iron golem lies in scrap. That was the bloodiest mile of the war.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
victory_epilogue.line: We stand beneath the Outer Rampart now. Nowhere left for the enemy to retreat.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Rest the wounded for one hour, then ready the siege towers.

m41-gauntlet-of-iron.defeat_line: Heavy iron portcullises slam shut behind and ahead, trapping your vanguard in a narrow canyon of crossfire and crushing steel.

optional_choice.prompt: Captured iron golem cores can either be rigged as demolition charges for the Outer Rampart or melted into heavy plate.
optional_choice.a: Rig the cores as volatile breach-charges for m42.
optional_choice.b: Reforge the golem plates into heavy infantry armor.
optional_choice.effect_a: Instantly breaches one outer gatehouse in m42; injures sappers during transport.
optional_choice.effect_b: Grants +15% physical armor for the remainder of Act 4; slows siege advance in m42.

m41-gauntlet-of-iron.codex_note: Cut straight through a vein of raw magnetic iron, the Gauntlet was engineered so a hundred defenders could bleed an army of ten thousand.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Molten rock glows sluggishly in the moat below the Infernal Citadel's towering basalt curtain wall.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Three outer gatehouses control the drawbridge winches. Crack at least two and we can drop that iron span across the lava.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: Listen to that rumble from the left flank—sounds like Thunder on the Glacis where their heavy mortars are bedded.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Focus assault teams on the West and Center gatehouses. Ignore the East tower unless a flank opens.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Watch for boiling pitch chutes above the gates. Keep the battering rams covered with wet hides.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Once that drawbridge drops, there's nothing between us and the inner courtyard.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Ladders up on the West wall! Keep suppressing fire on the battlements while the rams work!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: West gatehouse is ours! One winch down—push into the Center gatehouse before they counterattack!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: Stone brutes marching along the wall-walk! Bring up the heavy crossbows!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Both winches are cut. Drop the drawbridge!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
victory_epilogue.line: The iron span slammed down so hard it cracked the basalt lip on both sides. The inner courtyard is open!

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Our banners fly on the Outer Rampart, though scouts report dust plumes rising on three horizon roads.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Turn the rampart's defenses outward. If relief armies are coming, we meet them on our terms.

m42-outer-rampart.defeat_line: Boiling pitch and stone boulders shatter your siege rams at the moat's edge, leaving the drawbridge raised above a sea of fire.
m42-outer-rampart.codex_note: Fed by diverted magma channels from the central caldera, the Citadel's moat was built to turn failed assaults into cremations.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Three plumes of ash-dust converge across the blackened plain toward Three-Roads Watch behind your siege camp.

intro_scene.speaker: field-ash-scout
intro_scene.line: North, west, and east—three enemy relief columns marching to crush us against the citadel walls!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: If they link up around our camp, we're caught between the anvil and the hammer.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: The western column is escorting a Slag-Trench Convoy packed with siege powder—hit that and it'll blow half their vanguard.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: We defeat them in detail. Strike the fastest column first, then pivot before the others arrive.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: No digging in—mobility is the only thing keeping us alive today.

milestones.speaker: field-ash-scout
milestones.line: North column engaged! Break their vanguard quickly—the west host is less than a mile out!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: North road cleared! Pivot the cavalry west—hit them while they're still in march column!

milestones.speaker: field-siege-sapper
milestones.line: East column is hitting our camp perimeter! Hold the barricades until the main force wheels back!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Two columns broken. Shatter the eastern host and seal the sanctum.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Three relief armies scattered across the ash fields. No help is coming for whatever waits inside that vault.

victory_epilogue.speaker: field-ash-scout
victory_epilogue.line: The citadel is completely isolated. Even the crows have fled the caldera.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Gather the veterans. We enter the Crown Vault.

m43-three-roads-siege.defeat_line: Three relief armies slam into your camp simultaneously, crushing your surrounded host against the outer basalt walls.

optional_choice.prompt: Wounded deserters from the shattered relief columns beg for water and offer the password to the inner sanctum's side postern.
optional_choice.a: Share your scarce water rations to learn the postern password.
optional_choice.b: Conserve your water for the final assault and force the main vault doors.
optional_choice.effect_a: Unlocks a flanking entry in m44; reduces troop stamina by 10% due to water rationing.
optional_choice.effect_b: Preserves full troop stamina for m44; requires fighting through heavy front-door traps.

m43-three-roads-siege.codex_note: Three-Roads Watch marks the ancient crossroads where tribute caravans from the four provinces once converged before ascending to the Crown Vault.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Two colossal doors dominate the obsidian nave: one inlaid with pale silver stars, the other weeping liquid fire.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: The Threshold Chamber. Beyond the silver door lies the Altar of Order; beyond the molten seal burns the Obsidian Throne.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Listen to that eerie chanting from the upper galleries—like The Choir in the Nave singing through iron masks.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: First we clear the Arch-Warden's praetors guarding this hall. Then we decide what Thornvael becomes.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: The Crown of Order will purge the shadow, commander, though its light burns away everything forged in dark times.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: And the primal ember offers strength enough to rule the world—if it doesn't incinerate your soul first.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Praetors advancing in silent lockstep! Watch their polearms—they strike in unison!

milestones.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
milestones.line: The vault runes are reacting to our blood! Keep the center dais clear!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: Heat from the Ember Door is blistering our shields—finish the Arch-Warden's guard!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: The Arch-Warden falls. The threshold stands open.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
victory_epilogue.line: Both seals await your hand. Restore the Crown of Order, or claim the Ember Throne—there is no turning back.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: My veterans followed you through mud, tide, and ash. Whatever door you open, we stand behind you.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: The long march ends beyond these doors.

m44-threshold-choice.defeat_line: Struck down upon the Threshold dais, your blood feeds the twin seals while Thornvael burns unchallenged above.

optional_choice.prompt: Standing before the twin doors of destiny, you commit your expedition to its final path.
optional_choice.a: Unseal the Path of Order to restore the Crown and purge the shadow (Unlocks m45).
optional_choice.b: Break the Path of Ember to seize the primal flame and Dark Throne (Unlocks m46).
optional_choice.effect_a: Commits the campaign to Ending A (m45-crown-of-order); grants celestial ward aura.
optional_choice.effect_b: Commits the campaign to Ending B (m46-ember-reckoning); grants infernal wrath aura.

m44-threshold-choice.codex_note: Built at the exact geometric center of the caldera, the Threshold Chamber was designed so no sovereign could claim the Crown without confronting its fire.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Pale starlight pierces the cracked vault dome, illuminating a fractured marble altar choked with black ash.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: Bind the West and East Anchor Seals first. Until the celestial leylines stabilize, the altar will reject the Crown.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: Shadow praetorians are pouring from every alcove to smash those seals before we finish!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Hold both Anchor Seals at all costs. Once the light catches, the darkness has nowhere to hide.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
intro_scene.line: Be warned—the Crown's cleansing fire spares no corruption, not even the scars we carry.

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Better clean ash than an eternal rot. Hold the line.

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: Praetorians rushing the West Seal! Form a steel crescent around the rune-stone!

milestones.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
milestones.line: West Seal bound! Now hold the East Anchor while the leyline harmonics align!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: Shadow horrors dropping from the dome ribs! Keep them off the central altar!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Both seals are singing. Place the Crown upon the altar.

ambient_barks: Don't let them crack the rune!

victory_epilogue.speaker: narrator
victory_epilogue.line: White-gold radiance erupts from the Crown of Order, washing across the caldera like a silent tidal wave of dawn.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
victory_epilogue.line: The ash is turning to grey rain. For the first time in a generation, the sky above Thornvael is blue.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Lay down your shields. The realm is clean.

m45-crown-of-order.defeat_line: The Anchor Seals shatter into black dust, and an unyielding tide of shadow extinguishes the last starlight in Thornvael.
m45-crown-of-order.codex_note: Forged from fallen star-iron and tempered in mountain snow, the Crown of Order was meant to bind sovereigns to the welfare of the land.

intro_scene.speaker: narrator
intro_scene.line: Roaring magma illuminates the Obsidian Throne as primordial fire spirals upward into the vaulted dark.

intro_scene.speaker: ashkarath
intro_scene.line: So the dog finally climbs the ash-heap. Come, mortal—claim the flame if your bones can bear its weight.

intro_scene.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
intro_scene.line: Shatter the West and East Conduit Pillars! Those chains bind the primal fire to Ashkarath's wardens!

intro_scene.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
intro_scene.line: My veterans didn't bleed across four provinces to bow to a demon—or burn for nothing. Give the word!

intro_scene.speaker: ashkarath
intro_scene.line: Break the pillars and the fire will strip your flesh to cinders before you touch a single step!

intro_scene.speaker: hero
intro_scene.line: Smash the conduits. If Thornvael must be ruled by fire, it will be my hand holding the brand.

intro_scene.speaker: field-siege-sapper
intro_scene.line: Charges are set on the West Pillar! Clear the blast zone when the stone cracks!

intro_scene.speaker: ashkarath
intro_scene.line: Then burn, usurper! Let us see whose will is harder than obsidian!

milestones.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
milestones.line: West Conduit Pillar is cracking! Watch the molten backlash—keep your shields angled!

milestones.speaker: ashkarath
milestones.line: You dare unchain the deep fire? My wardens will tear your soul from your ribs!

milestones.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
milestones.line: The floor is splitting into magma vents! Push onto the Obsidian Dais—nowhere else is solid!

milestones.speaker: hero
milestones.line: Both conduits are shattered. Kneel, Ashkarath, or turn to ash.

ambient_barks: Crown of fire, throne of glass!

victory_epilogue.speaker: narrator
victory_epilogue.line: Primordial embers coil around your gauntlets like living gold as Ashkarath's legions drop to one knee across the hall.

victory_epilogue.speaker: ashkarath
victory_epilogue.line: The flame... answers you. Even the deep dark knows its master now.

victory_epilogue.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
victory_epilogue.line: Thornwick to the caldera—every banner bends to your word, my lord.

victory_epilogue.speaker: hero
victory_epilogue.line: Send word to the coast. A new age begins in iron and ember.

m46-ember-reckoning.defeat_line: The unchained fire surges through your veins, leaving nothing upon the Obsidian Throne but a hollow suit of blackened plate.
m46-ember-reckoning.codex_note: Carved from a single monolith of volcanic glass, the Obsidian Throne was left empty by the First Emperors, who feared any mortal who sat upon it would never die.
